Type: Multi-employer Pensionskasse under the Pensionskassengesetz, the only one in Austria not owned by a bank or an insurer
Can write US$50m: unclear - APK is the one Austrian Pensionskasse whose own published policy documents carry a double-digit strategic private equity quota, so a US$50m ticket is plausible in principle on a EUR 6.65bn book. It cannot be confirmed, because APK publishes no private equity euro figure, no fund list and no commitment sizes.
Who signs: commits in its own name and acts as its own gatekeeper - APK is the Dachfonds manager, asset allocator, risk manager and controller, and it hires external specialists to run the subfunds underneath. 'In der Wertschöpfungskette übernimmt die APK die Rolle des Dachfonds - Managers, Asset Allocators, des Risikomanagers und des Controllers. Von der APK ausgewählte, externe Veranlagungsspezialisten konzentrieren sich auf das Management des jeweiligen Subfonds.'
PE programme: no euro figure is published. APK publishes a strategic private equity quota per Veranlagungs- und Risikogemeinschaft instead. VRG 1 carries Private Equity 5% with a 0% to 15% band. VRG 3, VRG 9 and VRG 25 each carry Private Equity 10%. VRG 19 and VRG 23 Sub-VG 2 each carry Private Equity 15%, and VRG 19's tactical band has a FLOOR of 10% and a ceiling of 25%. Total veranlagtes Vermögen was EUR 6,652.9m at 31 December 2025, up from EUR 6,316.1m. The Alternatives segment, which APK reports separately from private equity, was about 16% of the portfolio at year end and ranges from 0% to 21% across the VRGen. https://www.apk-pensionskasse.at/index.php?eID=dumpFile&t=f&f=698&token=31a57f3158e435d84d2e502e3cf711c1492b2a5c, https://www.apk-pensionskasse.at/index.php?eID=dumpFile&t=f&f=699&token=26beffb57d43caf5b8846e11f2f0b82dda902830 and https://www.apk-pensionskasse.at/index.php?eID=dumpFile&t=f&f=2113&token=ac39c08f76c4d676d234f6a909e408785c348317 read 2026-09-19
Typical ticket: not published. APK's balance sheet shows EUR 2,970.0m in 'Aktien und sonstige Beteiligungswertpapiere' with no private equity split and no fund schedule. A 10% strategic quota on a EUR 6.65bn book would be a private equity programme of several hundred million euro, but APK does not publish the VRG sizes, so the euro figure cannot be derived from a published source. Inferred from the SAA tables and the total assets figure, and explicitly not verified.
Decides: Two-tier, and small. The Vorstand has two members. The Aufsichtsrat has fifteen, eight representing capital, six representing members and one the works council. The strategic and tactical allocation is set in an annual structured asset allocation process run by Veranlagung, Risikomanagement, Aktuariat and the Geschäftsführung. 'Alle strategischen und taktischen Entscheidungen im Bereich Veranlagung werden intern organisiert.'
Cadence: Annual for the strategic asset allocation, with the SAA and TAA validated and adjusted as needed in the same process. No committee meeting calendar is published.
Screened by: No external gatekeeper and no investment consultant is named in any published document. APK makes its independence the selling point. 'Als einzige Institution am Markt sind wir nicht im Besitz von Banken oder Versicherungen.' Manager selection runs on a Bestbieterprinzip with defined quantitative and qualitative criteria, and for non-conventional asset classes the qualitative criteria dominate. 'Bei nicht konventionellen Assetklassen stehen qualitative Kriterien im Mittelpunkt da quantitative Marktvergleiche nur bedingt möglich sind.'
Named people: Mag. Manfred Brenner (Mitglied des Vorstandes, first appointed 1 July 2022, appointed to 30 June 2027); Mag.a Beate Wolf (Mitglied des Vorstandes, first appointed 1 July 2022, appointed to 30 June 2027); Dr.in Valerie Hackl (Vorsitzende des Aufsichtsrates, first appointed 19 June 2024); Univ.-Prof. Dr. Teodoro D. Cocca (Mitglied des Aufsichtsrates, capital representative, first appointed 23 June 2021)
How far the check reached: Downloaded and text-extracted the APK Pensionskasse Geschäftsbericht 2025 and seven of the twenty-two published Erklärungen über die Grundsätze der Veranlagungspolitik, for VRG 1, 2, 3, 9, 19, 23 Sub-VG 2 and 25, which Austria requires to be published for every VRG under PKG Paragraph 25a Abs 3. Also read the Veranlagung page in full. Searched the Geschäftsbericht for Private Equity, Beteiligung, alternativ, Risikokapital, Dachfonds, Zielfonds, Verwahrstelle, Depotbank, Kapitalanlagegesellschaft, Asien, Asia, Emerging, Schwellenländer, Crown, LGT, Partners Group, Golding, Pantheon, StepStone and Ardian. The phrase Private Equity appears in the SIPPs and not once in the Geschäftsbericht. APK names no external manager, no custodian and no consultant in anything it publishes. The balance sheet gives only 'Aktien und sonstige Beteiligungswertpapiere 2.970.010.459,74' with no split. The remaining fifteen SIPPs were not opened.

Type: Multi-employer Pensionskasse under the Pensionskassengesetz, the largest in Austria, with a sister Vorsorgekasse under the BMSVG
Can write US$50m: no - US$50m is roughly EUR 43m, which is two and a half times VBV's whole private equity book of EUR 17.21m. VBV puts its illiquid money into private debt and infrastructure, not private equity.
Who signs: commits in its own name through in-house asset-class feeder funds - VBV runs Assetklassen-Dachfonds for Anleihen, Darlehen und Kredite, Aktien, Immobilien and Infrastruktur, managed by its own Front Office, and each Veranlagungs- und Risikogemeinschaft holds units in them. Private equity has no Dachfonds of its own in that list.
PE programme: private equity was EUR 17.21m, 0.2% of investments, at 31 December 2025, up from EUR 10.79m and 0.1% a year earlier. Total VBV-Pensionskasse investments in the same table were EUR 9,305.32m. Private Debt was EUR 867.23m and 9.3%, Infrastruktur EUR 654.54m and 7.0%, Immobilien EUR 388.92m and 4.2%. Veranlagtes Vermögen was EUR 9,793m at 31 December 2025 against EUR 9,380m a year earlier. https://www.vbv.at/fileadmin/CONTENT/Global/Berichte/2025/VBV_Nachhaltigkeitsbericht_2025.pdf and https://www.vbv.at/fileadmin/CONTENT/Global/Berichte/2025/VBV-Pensionskasse_Gesch%C3%A4ftsbericht_2025.pdf read 2026-09-19
Typical ticket: below EUR 20m for a private markets fund, and much smaller in private equity. The entire private equity book is EUR 17.21m. Inferred from the asset-class table in the Nachhaltigkeitsbericht 2025, which is the only place VBV publishes a private equity figure. No per-fund commitment is published anywhere.
Decides: Two-tier. The Vorstand has three members and Veranlagung is the CEO's own portfolio. The Aufsichtsrat has fifteen members. Strategic asset allocation for each of the 29 VRGen and VGen is set once a year in an ALM and SAA process run jointly by Veranlagung, Risikomanagement, Aktuariat and Geschäftsführung. Product selection runs a structured multi-stage process against the FMA-Mindeststandards zur Due Diligence für Geschäftspartner, with a market comparison, and it is documented in writing.
Cadence: Strategic asset allocation is optimised annually. Tactical bands are managed continuously by the Front Office, with reference to the responsible Vorstand or Risikomanagement where needed. The Erklärung über die Grundsätze der Veranlagungspolitik is dated October 2025.
Screened by: No external gatekeeper and no investment consultant is named in any published VBV document. The investment function is the internal Front Office, Mid Office and Back Office. Pooled vehicles are the normal implementation route. 'In der Regel werden gepoolte Investmentvehikel (z.B. Investmentfonds) verwendet.'
Named people: Mag. Günther Schiendl (Vorstandsvorsitzender, CEO, and the board member responsible for Veranlagung); Mag. Ronald Laszlo (Mitglied des Vorstandes, responsible for Risikomanagement); Mag. Christian Reiss (Mitglied des Vorstandes, responsible for Berechtigten-Service and Vertrieb); Mag. Markus Posch (Vorsitzender des Aufsichtsrates)
How far the check reached: Downloaded and text-extracted three primary documents. The VBV-Pensionskasse Geschäftsbericht 2025, the VBV Nachhaltigkeitsbericht 2025, and the Erklärung über die Grundsätze der Veranlagungspolitik dated October 2025, which Austria requires to be published for every VRG under PKG Paragraph 25a Abs 3. Also downloaded the VBV-Vorsorgekasse Geschäftsbericht 2025. Searched all four for Private Equity, Beteiligung, alternativ, Risikokapital, Infrastruktur, Asien, Asia, Emerging, Schwellenländer, Crown, LGT, Partners Group, Golding, Pantheon, StepStone, Ardian, Hamilton Lane, Amundi, BlackRock, Schroders, Verwahrstelle and Depotbank. The string Private Equity appears nowhere in the Geschäftsbericht 2025. It appears twice in the Nachhaltigkeitsbericht, in the PCAF financed-emissions table, which is where the EUR 17.21m figure comes from. VBV names no external asset manager, no custodian and no consultant in any published document checked.

Institution: Valida Pension AG (Valida Pensionskasse), part of Valida Holding AG
Type: Multi-employer Pensionskasse under the Pensionskassengesetz, owned by Raiffeisen Bank International and UNIQA, sitting in a group with the Valida Plus AG Vorsorgekasse
Can write US$50m: unclear - EUR 7.891bn is large enough in principle, and Valida says it is building unlisted assets over a multi-year period, but no private equity allocation, band or amount is published anywhere, so the ticket cannot be sized.
Who signs: commits in its own name through its Asset Management department and Austrian Spezial-Dachfonds - 'Fondsanteile, welche direkt auf VG-Ebene oder in einem österreichischen Spezial-Dachfonds gehalten werden, werden jeweils einer Assetklasse zugeordnet.' The strategic asset allocation is defined by Asset Management within limits the Pensionskasse sets.
PE programme: no private equity figure is published. Valida Pension AG held EUR 7.891bn in its Veranlagungs- und Risikogemeinschaften at 31 December 2025, and the Valida group held EUR 13.62bn against EUR 12.71bn a year earlier. The group's asset allocation charts use a 'Sonstige Investments' bucket rather than a private equity line. https://www.valida.at/resources/valida/valida/downloads/pdfs/GB_2025.pdf read 2026-09-19
Typical ticket: not disclosed. Valida publishes no fund list, no commitment sizes and no private equity euro figure.
Decides: Two-tier at holding level. The Valida Holding AG Vorstand has three members and the Aufsichtsrat is dominated by the shareholders, with three Raiffeisen Bank International seats, two UNIQA seats and one GRAWE Bankengruppe seat alongside three works-council delegates. The asset allocation itself is produced by the Asset Management department from asset and liability studies, and the resulting model portfolio respects limits the Pensionskasse sets per asset class. Manager selection runs against the FMA-Mindeststandards zur Due Diligence für Geschäftspartner and is documented in writing.
Cadence: Not published. The Geschäftsbericht describes SAA changes taking effect in mid-December for the following year, and tactical changes month by month through 2025.
Screened by: No external gatekeeper or investment consultant is named. Valida uses an external Overlay-Manager for the Valida Risiko-Overlay-Modell, unnamed in the report, and says it entrusts the money to 'renommierten internationalen und nationalen Investment-Managern' without naming one. Risk and it governance run on Raiffeisen Bank International group processes.
Named people: Mag. Martin Sardelic (Vorstandsvorsitzender der Valida Holding AG); Dr. Philipp Mayer (Mitglied des Vorstandes der Valida Holding AG); DI (FH) Elisabeth Radocha (Mitglied des Vorstandes der Valida Holding AG); Dr. Christian Geberth (Aufsichtsratsvorsitzender der Valida Holding AG, Valida Pension AG und Valida Plus AG, in post since the extraordinary general meeting of 26 February 2026)
How far the check reached: Downloaded and text-extracted the Valida Geschäftsbericht 2025, which covers Valida Holding AG, Valida Pension AG and Valida Plus AG, and the Allgemeine Grundsätze der Veranlagungspolitik, which Austria requires to be published under PKG Paragraph 25a Abs 3. Searched both for Private Equity, Risikokapital, alternativ, Infrastruktur, Dachfonds, Master, Asien, Asia, Emerging, Schwellenländer, Crown, LGT and Partners Group. Type: Statutory supplementary labour-market pension for 5.8m Danes; largest Danish pension institution
Can write US$50m: yes - ATP is the largest institution in this universe, its unlisted equity book is DKK 93.2bn, and its private-equity arm alone manages over EUR 11bn. A US$50m ticket is small for it.
Who signs: split - fund commitments in private equity are made by ATP Private Equity Partners, a captive fund-of-funds arm managed through Private Equity Advisors ApS and Private Equity Advisors AIFM A/S, which 'was founded in 2001 as the independent private equity arm of the Danish pension fund, ATP' and targets 'funds across Europe and North America'. The Asian positions on ATP's own statutory list sit outside that stated mandate, so at least some Asia exposure is bought at ATP group level rather than through ATP PEP. https://atp-pep.com/
PE programme: ATP's unlisted equity holdings were DKK 93,242m fair value at 31 December 2025, down from DKK 108,298m a year earlier. Of that, the private-equity lines in the fair-value hierarchy note total DKK 44,171m (DKK 8,162m at recent transaction prices, DKK 33,198m at reported fair value, DKK 688m by multiple analysis and DKK 2,123m by discounted cash flow). Separately, ATP Private Equity Partners manages more than EUR 11bn of assets. https://www.atp.dk/dokument/aarsrapport-atp-koncernen-2025 and https://atp-pep.com/
Typical ticket: not published. ATP's statutory specification gives the fund's own equity and ATP's ownership band, never ATP's commitment. Institution: BASF Pensionskasse VVaG (with BASF Pensionstreuhand e.V., the group CTA)
Type: Corporate pension in two pots. A BaFin-supervised Pensionskasse in the legal form of a Versicherungsverein auf Gegenseitigkeit carries the basic benefit level. A Contractual Trust Arrangement, BASF Pensionstreuhand e.V., carries the promises above that level. There is no BASF Pensionsfonds.
Can write US$50m: unclear, leaning yes on capacity and no on the vehicle as Pavilion currently offers it. Capacity: a EUR 1.6bn private equity book across 37 funds with EUR 214.3m of live undrawn commitments can absorb US$50m, which is about 3 percent of that book. Structure: the Pensionskasse says in its own words that 'Die qualitativen und quantitativen Vorgaben der Anlageverordnung fuer Pensionskassen, Sterbekassen und kleine Versicherungsunternehmen stellen diesbezueglich den regulatorischen Rahmen dar', so AnlV § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 13 Buchstabe b applies and a Singapore-law or Cayman-law closed-ended fund managed from Singapore cannot enter its Sicherungsvermoegen at all. Only a Luxembourg or Irish parallel vehicle with an EEA manager works, and BASF already runs exactly that plumbing, since every private equity position it holds is subscribed by BAA, SICAV in Luxembourg. Quota: AnlV § 3 Abs. 3 caps the unlisted share at 15 percent of the Sicherungsvermoegen, EUR 1,551m against EUR 10,340.8m, and the BAA holding is EUR 1,089.2m at book, so nominal headroom is about EUR 460m before infrastructure equity held inside the two mixed Dachfonds is deducted. The Pensionskasse noted with approval that on 7 February 2025 the risk-capital quota rose from 35 to 40 percent and a separate 5 percent infrastructure quota arrived. The second pot, BASF Pensionstreuhand e.V., is a CTA, is not AnlV-bound and could take an offshore vehicle directly, but it publishes nothing and its governance is invisible from outside. Fit: BASF's private equity is already predominantly funds-of-funds, so a pan-Asia fund-of-funds competes with the global funds-of-funds it owns rather than filling a gap, and the manager list inside BAA is undisclosed so the overlap cannot be tested.
Who signs: Pooled internally through one Luxembourg vehicle. BAA, SICAV was founded in 2007 and is 96.8 percent owned by the Pensionskasse; its stated purpose in the Luxembourg register is 'particularly the worldwide participation in Private Equity and Mezzanine Funds'. Liquid assets run through eight Universal Investment Spezialfonds under a tripartite Dreiervereinbarung of unlimited term: two gemischte Dachfonds at EUR 5,137.7m, one Rentenfonds at EUR 2,392.7m and five Immobilienfonds at EUR 751.6m. Private equity bypasses the KVG entirely. The subscription document for a fund is signed by the Verwaltungsrat of BAA in Luxembourg rather than by the Pensionskasse, which is an inference from the structure and not a BASF statement.
PE programme: private equity is EUR 1,604.6m of net assets inside BAA, SICAV at its 30 September 2025 year end, invested across 37 private equity funds described as 'vorwiegend Dachfonds'. The Pensionskasse carries the holding at EUR 1,089.2m book and EUR 1,484.8m fair value at 31 December 2025, about 12.2 percent of Kapitalanlagen at fair value. Undrawn commitments were EUR 214.3m at 31 December 2025 against EUR 239.3m a year earlier, and capital calls ran EUR 25.0m in 2025 and EUR 68.2m in 2024. https://www.basf.com/dam/jcr:e9d6451c-d04c-4d56-9707-608eabb3eb0c/basf/www/global/de/documents/Ludwigshafen/working-at-the-site/pensionskasse/BASF-Pensionskasse-VVaG_Gesch-ftsbericht-2025.pdf read 2026-09-19. At group level, Alternative Investments inside the IAS 19 plan assets are EUR 5,573m of EUR 20,290m, 27.5 percent, defined as 'Anlagen in Private- und Infrastructure-Equity, Absolute-Return-Fonds und besicherte Unternehmensdarlehen'. https://bericht.basf.com/2025/de/konzernabschluss/anhang/rueckstellungen-fuer-pensionen.html read 2026-09-19

Type: Berufsständisches Versorgungswerk for dentists. 'Eine teilrechtsfähige, wirtschaftlich selbstständige Einrichtung der Zahnärztekammer Nordrhein, Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts, mit Sitz in Düsseldorf.' Chosen as the entity to research because it is the largest dentists-only Versorgungswerk that could be evidenced and the only one of the two named candidates that is a functioning prospect.
Can write US$50m: yes on size, unevidenced in practice, and only into a Luxembourg or Irish vehicle. On size, a EUR 4.5bn scheme with a private-markets programme of roughly EUR 1.3bn including undrawn commitments can carry a US$50m line, which would be about 1.1 percent of total assets. On the record, no single VZN fund commitment of that scale is visible. Every named direct private-markets position in the 2022 accounts has an undrawn balance under EUR 21m. On structure, VZN states its own AnlV binding. 'Das VZN befindet sich nach dem zwischen ABV und Landesaufsichtsbehörden abgestimmten Einstufungs-Modell in Risikostufe 3. Damit unterliegt das VZN der Anlageverordnung des VAG, der Anlageverordnung des Landes NRW sowie dem BaFin-Rundschreiben 11/2017.' Under § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 13 b AnlV a closed-ended foreign fund is admissible to the Sicherungsvermögen only where it is governed by the law of an EEA state or a full OECD member state and is managed by a company seated in the EEA or a full OECD member state. Singapore and the Cayman Islands are neither, so a Singapore-law or Cayman-law Pavilion master fund is inadmissible and only a Luxembourg or Irish parallel vehicle works. That ask is easy here, because VZN already routes all of its private markets through a Luxembourg fund. https://web.archive.org/web/20231003214654if_/https://www.vzn-nordrhein.de/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/VZN_GB_2022_web.pdf and https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/anlv_2016/__2.html read 2026-09-19
Who signs: commits in its own name, through its own Luxembourg fund UZN-LUX for private markets and through a German Master-KVG for the securities book. The Master-KVG is referenced but never named. 'Die Überwachung dieser Risikovorgaben erfolgt durch unser Risikocontrolling und die Master-KVG.' The German master fund is called the UZN Masterfonds, launched March 2003, EUR 910,634,543.23 at 31 December 2022. The Verwahrstelle changed to BNP Paribas Securities Services in September 2024. https://web.archive.org/web/20231003214654if_/https://www.vzn-nordrhein.de/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/VZN_GB_2022_web.pdf and https://www.portfolio-institutionell.de/versorgungswerk-der-zahnaerztekammer-nordrhein-wechselt-verwahrstelle/ read 2026-09-19
PE programme: private markets are bundled in a single Luxembourg fund, UZN-LUX, which stood at EUR 472,225,524.68 book value at 31 December 2022, 12.30 percent of EUR 3,837,739,969.97 total Kapitalanlagen. 'Mit unserem Luxemburger Fonds, in dem unsere Private Markets-Investments gebündelt sind, konnten wir ein erfreuliches Ergebnis in einer Größenordnung von plus 13,53 % erzielen, was einmal mehr die Sinnhaftigkeit des Anlagebausteins Private Markets unterstreicht.' On top of the book value, VZN carried EUR 860,000,000.00 of undrawn Einzahlungsverpflichtungen to UZN-LUX alone, out of EUR 1,130,973,990.68 of total financial commitments. https://web.archive.org/web/20231003214654if_/https://www.vzn-nordrhein.de/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/VZN_GB_2022_web.pdf read 2026-09-19. Total Kapitalanlagen were reported as about EUR 4.5bn in September 2024. https://www.portfolio-institutionell.de/versorgungswerk-der-zahnaerztekammer-nordrhein-wechselt-verwahrstelle/

Type: Berufsständisches Versorgungswerk for physicians. Einrichtung der Ärztekammer Westfalen-Lippe, Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts, supervised by the NRW finance ministry.
Can write US$50m: yes on size, no on current strategy, and only into a Luxembourg vehicle. Size is not the issue. Kapitalanlagen are EUR 15,745.7m and the alternatives sleeve alone is EUR 3,029m, so US$50m is an ordinary line. The AnlV is the gate. ÄVWL is AnlV-bound through Satzung § 30 Abs. 3, VAG NRW and § 7 VersAufsVO NRW, and § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 13 b AnlV admits units in a closed-ended foreign fund only where the fund is governed by the law of an EEA state or a full OECD member state and is managed by a company seated in the EEA or a full OECD member state. Singapore and the Cayman Islands are neither, so a Singapore-law or Cayman-law Pavilion master fund is inadmissible to the Sicherungsvermögen. Three things soften that. § 7 VersAufsVO NRW ends 'Die Aufsichtsbehörde kann Abweichungen zulassen'. ÄVWL was the first Versorgungswerk in NRW granted the Erweiterte Öffnungsklausel, in 2016, and still used it in FY2025. And every alternative it owns already sits in a Luxembourg specialised investment fund, the Lux FIS umbrella, so a Luxembourg parallel vehicle with an EEA AIFM clears § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 13 b outright and matches a structure ÄVWL already operates. The real obstacle is region. Its private equity and private debt book is stated as 'mit regionalem Schwerpunkt in Europa und den USA' and ten years of annual reports name no Asia manager. https://aevwl.de/wp-content/uploads/Satzung_AEVWL_2026.pdf and https://www.bundestag.de/resource/blob/1103568/WD-6-004-25.pdf read 2026-09-19
Who signs: commits in its own name, through its own Luxembourg fund. ÄVWL selects and executes in house with no external gatekeeper and no named investment consultant. Alternatives are bundled into the ÄVWL-Fonds Lux FIS umbrella. 'Die Alternative-Spezialfonds der ÄVWL umfassen sowohl einen aus zwei Teilfonds (Lux FIS I und Lux FIS II) bestehenden Spezialfonds zur Bündelung alternativer Anlagen als auch zwei weitere Fonds zur Strukturierung von Infrastrukturinvestitionen.' The German securities Spezialfonds were administered by HSBC INKA at least through 2018, evidenced by ÄVWL naming its own funds 'HSBC AWL', 'HSBC AVS' and 'HSBC EML' in the 2016 to 2018 reports; the naming stops after 2018 and the current Master-KVG is not published. https://aevwl.de/wp-content/uploads/AEVWL_Geschaeftsbericht_2025.pdf read 2026-09-19
PE programme: no standalone private equity figure is published. The container is. Alternative-Spezialfonds total EUR 3,029m at 31 December 2025. 'Der gesamte Bereich der Alternative-Spezialfonds mit einem Volumen von 3.029 Millionen Euro erwirtschaftete im Jahr 2025 eine Nettokapitalrendite von 3,1 Prozent.' Inside that sleeve, the Luxembourg sub-fund Lux FIS I holds 'mehr als 100 Beteiligungen an unterschiedlichen Zielfonds' across private equity, direct lending, infrastructure and turnaround. Total Kapitalanlagen were EUR 15,745.7m at 31 December 2025. https://aevwl.de/wp-content/uploads/AEVWL_Geschaeftsbericht_2025.pdf and https://aevwl.de/die-aevwl-auf-einen-blick/ read 2026-09-19. The balance-sheet line 'Beteiligungen' of EUR 3,731,390.61 is a different thing and is not the private equity book.
Typical ticket: EUR 20m to EUR 50m per target fund, inferred from a EUR 3,029m alternatives sleeve spread across more than 100 live target-fund positions in Lux FIS I plus separate infrastructure vehicles. Commitments run larger than net asset value and vintages overlap, so the commitment-level ticket is above that arithmetic average. No per-fund commitment amount appears in any ÄVWL document. Low confidence. https://aevwl.de/wp-content/uploads/AEVWL_Geschaeftsbericht_2025.pdf
Decides: Aufsichtsausschuss sets the investment rulebook. Satzung § 4 Abs. 6 Nr. 4, 'die Aufstellung von Richtlinien für die Kapitalanlage der Ärzteversorgung Westfalen-Lippe'. It has 12 members and is chaired by Dr. med. Patricia Kalle-Droste. The Verwaltungsausschuss runs the business, has 8 members, is chaired by Prof. Dr. med. Peter Czeschinski, and must include one member 'im Bereich der Kapitalanlage erfahren'. The three-person hauptamtliche Geschäftsführung executes individual fund commitments inside those guidelines. No separate Anlageausschuss exists. A single fund commitment is an executive act, which is the practical entry point.
Cadence: F: Aufsichtsausschuss meets regularly one month after the accounts, annual report and audit report are tabled, at the latest 8 months after the financial year end, and otherwise on request of four of its members or two Verwaltungsausschuss members (Satzung § 4 Abs. 4). The Verwaltungsausschuss must report to it 'Regelmäßig, mindestens vierteljährlich'. An annual ALM-Studie was run in 2023, 2024 and 2025.
Screened by: None. Zero hits for Golding, YIELCO, Alpha Portfolio Advisors, Astorius, Pantheon, Allianz GI Alternatives, FERI, Mercer and WTW across all ten annual reports 2016 to 2025. Andreas Weigl of Faros Consulting and Dirk Grosshans of Universal Investment appear on the ÄVWL site only as award jury chair and award presenter, which is not a mandate. ÄVWL is itself an investment service provider to other Versorgungswerke, including the Versorgungswerk der Tierärztekammer Westfalen-Lippe.

Under that model 'equity risk is modelled by associating each equity exposure to a market index representative of its industrial sector and/or geography', with potential changes in market value estimated from past shocks on the selected indices. So Generali does not apply the standard formula's 49% Type 2 charge under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35 Art 168(3) and 169(2)(b), and the Art 171a long-term-equity relief being EEA-only is irrelevant to it. The Group Solvency Ratio was 218.9% at 31/12/2025 against 209.7% a year earlier, SCR EUR 24,004 million and MCR EUR 17,774 million. The SCR for financial risks was EUR 13,412 million before diversification, 35.8% of total SCR before diversification, and EUR 11,616 million after diversification, 41.3% of total SCR after diversification, with the SFCR stating that 'the most relevant financial risk for the Group is equity risk'. The duration-based equity risk sub-module of Art 304 is 'not applicable to Generali Group'. The Group also says it is 'pursuing the diversification to alternative asset classes and increasing the target allocation to private markets, which are deemed more attractive than public markets both in terms of absolute return and Solvency II impact', and that 'On Private equity we kept subscribing new committments to keep the long term target of increasing exposure for the asset class'.
